Chapter 1079 18 Changes In The Inner Universe (Subscription Request)

Chapter 1079 18 Changes in the Inner Universe (Subscription Request)

"Senior... What does the Senior mean?"

Cang Yulong shivered in spirit.

Hide until when?

I've always been here.

Not hiding at all.

Who is Lin Yuan referring to?

In a flash of insight, Cang Yulong realized...

The greatest secret on him had probably been discovered by Lin Yuan.

Nine Profound Venerable discovered that Mysterious Space, and Cang Yulong, through other means, transmitted inside ahead of time.

At the very moment of entering that Mysterious Space, a consciousness appeared in his mind, a childlike voice that had been communicating with Cang Yulong on a mental level.

The childlike voice claimed to be the Protector inherited within that Mysterious Space, and had already chosen Cang Yulong as its heir.

At first, Cang Yulong was half skeptical, but later, the many pointers from the childlike voice benefited Cang Yulong immensely, and he finally believed it.

Unfortunately, before taking away that Mysterious Space, Nine Profound Venerable had a brief meeting of eyes with Cang Yulong, forming a causal relationship between them.

Eventually, under the relentless search of a Venerable, Cang Yulong was still captured.

Even so, facing the day and night torture of the Sinister Pool, it was the childlike voice in his mind that bore most of the pain.

Otherwise, Cang Yulong wouldn't have been able to persevere until now.

The childlike voice was extremely hidden, even Nine Profound Venerable had not detected anything unusual.

Originally, Cang Yulong thought that Lin Yuan wouldn't be able to discover it either.

But to his surprise, it was still seen through by Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan could sense another wave of consciousness within Cang Yulong, entirely because of his internal universe.

When forcibly taking Cang Yulong from the Nine Profound Secret Realm, Lin Yuan along the way included him into his internal universe.

Lin Yuan's internal universe had been transformed by the thirteenth stage inheritance, "Infinite Void", which not only matched the internal universe of a Chaos Venerable in size.

But in the sense of subtle power, it was actually stronger than the average Chaos Venerable.

After all, "Infinite Void" derived from a thirteenth stage time-life, representing a foundational inheritance.

Lin Yuan's true body and two Primordial Spirits, all cultivated into the first layer of the "Infinite Void".

Of course, purely in the attainment of this inheritance, the true body is slightly stronger.

It was because of this.

If before the true form appeared, Lin Yuan only vaguely sensed consciousness fluctuations on Cang Yulong.

He wasn't very sure.

Then when the true form arrived, it was basically confirmed.

The reason Lin Yuan's true form appeared beside Cang Yulong, aside from executing a sky-tearing grab, was to use the internal universe of the true form to confirm the consciousness fluctuation on the other.

"Senior, I..."

Cang Yulong was about to speak.

Immediately, the childlike voice echoed in his mind again, "No need to say more, since I've been discovered, there's no need to hide."

The childlike voice was very clear that with Lin Yuan's realm and strength, once speaking such words, it was certainly with enough assurance.

Besides, even without assurance, what could be done? As long as Lin Yuan became suspicious, he had to come out.

Cang Yulong suddenly closed his eyes, and when he opened them again, they had become incredibly deep and calm, as if containing universes within.

Lin Yuan observed Cang Yulong and, seeing this, his expression immediately became solemn, "Are you indeed a Venerable... or a Great Saint?"

The current 'Cang Yulong' gave Lin Yuan a very special feeling, akin to facing the imprint left by the Moyu Tower Master on the ninth floor of the Black Tower, the aura vast and encompassing the Chaos Void.

Of course, purely from the intensity of the aura, the 'Cang Yulong' before him was certainly not as formidable as the Moyu Tower Master, but both were generally at the same level.

That's why Lin Yuan inquired if the other was a Great Saint.

"Great Saint?"

'Cang Yulong' smiled slightly, "I indeed was once, but not anymore now."

"You were?"

Lin Yuan scrutinized the other, his expression rather puzzled.

At the level of a Great Saint, even if only a remnant soul remained, it could quickly recover; why maintain such a half-dead state of will?

"Simply put, I am no longer myself. I am merely a soul fragment refined by the real me..."

'Cang Yulong' explained straightforwardly without beating around the bush.

"Soul fragment?"

Lin Yuan's heart stirred.

The so-called soul fragment is entirely different from an avatar.

The true form and avatar share one consciousness, strictly speaking, belonging to one living being; if the avatar is subjected to memory tampering and other means, the true form would also be affected.

But the true form and soul fragment... are already considered two separate entities, the soul fragment has developed a new consciousness, yet due to originating from the true form, its consciousness, personality, habits, and memories, all inherit from the true form.

However, no matter how it is, the soul fragment and true form do not count as one living being.

Normally, no strong individual would be willing to refine a soul fragment, due to the risk of 'devouring the master.'

"Correct."

'Cang Yulong' nodded.

The soul fragment inherits all from the true form, but the understanding of realm and strength rules? That's not possible to inherit, so it cannot restore the strength of the Great Saint level.

In fact, if a soul fragment could inherit the rule comprehension of the true form, it would absolutely cause uproars with Great Saints refining batches of soul fragments.

Nonetheless, strength and rule comprehension can't be inherited, but the vision of the Great Saint level remains, and with incredibly rich cultivation experience, often able to see through the issues and confusions faced by a cultivator at a glance.

Therefore, when a Great Saint chooses to refine his soul fragment, it is basically to train an heir.

Additionally, a soul fragment has one most important function; if the Great Saint dies, with both true body and avatar dead, it would not extend to the soul fragment.
